SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS gross_rpt, sum(r.returns_net) AS ret_rpt, sum(r.net_sales) AS net_rpt, count(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS nstores, max(r.store_id) AS mxstore FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH s AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS staff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL),
r AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, st.store_id, sum(f.refund_net) AS ret_net
 FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.return_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week,
 sum(sales_net) AS all_sales, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN sales_net ELSE 0 END) AS train_sales, sum(staff) AS staff,
 sum(coalesce(ret_net,0)) AS all_ret, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN coalesce(ret_net,0) ELSE 0 END) AS train_ret, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN sales_net ELSE 0 END) AS web_sales, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN coalesce(ret_net,0) ELSE 0 END) AS web_ret
FROM s FULL JOIN r USING(fiscal_year, fiscal_week, store_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH f AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS fact_net, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-07' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_net, sum(receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-07' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(f.store_id, r.store_id) sid, fact_net, rpt_net, round(coalesce(fact_net,0)-coalesce(rpt_net,0),2) diff, n, rc FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.store_id=r.store_id WHERE abs(coalesce(fact_net,0)-coalesce(rpt_net,0))>0.5 OR fact_net IS NULL OR rpt_net IS NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) AS tot, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_store, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)-f.gross_amount)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badqty, max(f.net_amount) AS mx, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_ts_utc::date<>f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ts_date_diff, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at::date) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) AS dist_sl, sum(CASE WHEN s.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_sale, sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net>s.net_amount+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_refund, sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<s.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS before_sale, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan, sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s USING(sales_line_id) LEFT JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND st.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1,2),
rets AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND st.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1,2),
net AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week))
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, c.fiscal_week, c.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, p.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
  round((c.net_sales / p.net_sales - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM net c JOIN net p ON p.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND p.fiscal_week = c.fiscal_week
WHERE c.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY c.fiscal_week
